UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information for Sanatan Seva Samiti members.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

preferredLanguage.description: The user's selected language code (hi, sa, en, gu, mr, bn).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

SevaPledge.title: SevaPledge
SevaPledge.description: User seva resolution and activity registration.

pledgeId.description: Unique identifier for the seva pledge.

userId.description: The user UID who took the pledge.

category.description: Category of seva (e.g. Gau Seva, Anna Daan, Sanskar Shala).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the pledge was recorded.

NotificationLog.title: NotificationLog
NotificationLog.description: Dispatched push notification history record in Firestore.

id.description: Unique document identifier for the notification log.

body.description: The notification body (HTML/formatted text up to 240 chars).

imageUrl.description: Banner image attachment URL or path.

extraData.description: Optional route payload or deep link parameters.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the notification was dispatched.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles with access restricted to the authenticated owner.

/notification_logs/{logId}.description: Dispatched push notifications history log collection.
